fixed.summary: The default pack's motion is stronger: a control squashes to 0.94x under a press and springs back with a visible bounce (damping 0.42); a screen leaves in 120 ms and the next one enters in 180 ms from 1.04x; a dialog pops in from 0.9x on its own spring (damping 0.45, 340 ms response) with one overshoot. motion.css's pop row takes a damping and a duration like the press row.
